fullHistory.content: Give a brief, friendly welcome overview of what you can help with in this project. Use markdown with emoji section headers. Cover: Poses & Movement, Physics Simulation, Joint & Hand Control, and Code & Controls. Never use the word "Animations" — always say "Physics Simulation" instead. Keep it concise around 8–10 lines.

## 👋 Welcome to Your Roba Studio Project!

### 🤸‍♂️ Poses & Movement  
Create and test expressive robot postures—raise arms, tilt the head, or strike a T‑pose using the built‑in `data.ctrl` array.

### 🧩 Physics Simulation  
Roba Studio runs on the MuJoCo engine, giving you realistic dynamics, collision handling, and friction for every body and joint.

### 🤖 Joint & Hand Control  
Fine‑tune each joint (shoulders, elbows, wrist, fingers) with precise control ranges, and combine actuators to lift arms against gravity.

### 💻 Code & Controls  
Edit `src/main.js` to set control signals, add keyboard shortcuts, or hook up UI sliders—everything runs live in the browser.
